scenes.tts: If neurons are made in excess and the target decides who stays, what exactly would the target be doing?
scenes.visual: Title card: A Limiting Supply. Many axons reach toward one target tissue.
scenes.narration: If neurons are made in excess and the target decides who stays, what exactly would the target be doing?

scenes.tts: The neurotrophic hypothesis puts it in one line. Neurons compete for a limiting amount of neurotrophic factor for survival.
scenes.visual: The one line appears on screen: neurons compete for a limiting amount of neurotrophic factor for survival.
scenes.narration: The neurotrophic hypothesis puts it in one line. Neurons compete for a limiting amount of neurotrophic factor for survival.

scenes.tts: The targets supply it. Axons that reach these tissues take it up.
scenes.visual: A target releases a fixed number of factor particles; axons reaching it pick some up. More axons than particles.
scenes.narration: The targets supply it. Axons that reach these tissues take it up.

scenes.tts: Neurons that get too little die by apoptosis, a built-in program of cell death.
scenes.visual: Unfed neurons fade out. Label: apoptosis, a built-in program of cell death. Illustrative, not counts.
scenes.narration: Neurons that get too little die by apoptosis, a built-in program of cell death.

scenes.tts: Stated this way, the hypothesis makes predictions you can check one at a time.
scenes.visual: A five-item checklist appears, all boxes empty.
scenes.narration: Stated this way, the hypothesis makes predictions you can check one at a time.

scenes.tts: Remove the target, and more neurons die. Hamburger's wing-bud removal, read across time, fits.
scenes.visual: Item 1: remove target, more die. A tick appears, with the note: chick wing bud, 1934 and 1949.
scenes.narration: Remove the target, and more neurons die. Hamburger's wing-bud removal, read across time, fits.

scenes.tts: Add target, and fewer die.
scenes.visual: Item 2: add target, fewer die. Box still empty.
scenes.narration: Add target, and fewer die.

scenes.tts: Add factor, and fewer die. Remove factor, and more die.
scenes.visual: Items 3 and 4: add factor, fewer die; remove factor, more die. Boxes empty.
scenes.narration: Add factor, and fewer die. Remove factor, and more die.

scenes.tts: And most of the death should happen around the time axons reach the target and begin to compete.
scenes.visual: Item 5: most death when axons reach the target. A timeline with axons arriving and a death period marked.
scenes.narration: And most of the death should happen around the time axons reach the target and begin to compete.

scenes.tts: That is a checklist. The rest of this lesson tests the first four items, one at a time.
scenes.visual: The checklist, with one tick and four empty boxes. Items 1 to 4 highlighted; item 5, timing, greyed.
scenes.narration: That is a checklist. The rest of this lesson tests the first four items, one at a time.

scenes.tts: In nineteen seventy-six, Margaret Hollyday and Viktor Hamburger tested the second item.
scenes.caption: In 1976, Margaret Hollyday and Viktor Hamburger tested the second item.
scenes.visual: Credit: Hollyday and Hamburger, 1976. Item 2 highlighted.
scenes.narration: In 1976, Margaret Hollyday and Viktor Hamburger tested the second item.

scenes.tts: They grafted an extra leg onto chick embryos, beside the normal one.
scenes.visual: Schematic chick embryo with an extra leg grafted beside the normal leg.
scenes.narration: They grafted an extra leg onto chick embryos, beside the normal one.

scenes.tts: Predict. With more target, what should happen to the lumbar motor neurons, before the normal loss and after it?
scenes.visual: Question card: lumbar motor neurons with an extra leg: before the normal loss, and after it?
scenes.narration: Predict. With more target, what should happen to the lumbar motor neurons, before the normal loss and after it?

scenes.tts: At day six, before the normal loss, there were no more motor neurons than usual.
scenes.caption: At day 6, before the normal loss, there were no more motor neurons than usual.
scenes.visual: Two bars at day 6, graft and control, equal. Label: before the normal loss. Schematic bars, not data.
scenes.narration: At day 6, before the normal loss, there were no more motor neurons than usual.

scenes.tts: Later, more motor neurons remained, in embryos whose grafts moved vigorously.
scenes.visual: Two bars later in development: the graft side taller. Note: embryos whose grafts moved vigorously.
scenes.narration: Later, more motor neurons remained, in embryos whose grafts moved vigorously.

scenes.tts: They proposed a word for it. Hypo-thanasia: not extra birth, but reduced death.
scenes.visual: The word hypothanasia on screen: not extra birth, but reduced death. Item 2 ticked.
scenes.narration: They proposed a word for it. Hypo-thanasia: not extra birth, but reduced death.

scenes.tts: One caution. That result came from motor neurons, and they do not depend on N G F.
scenes.caption: One caution. That result came from motor neurons, and they do not depend on NGF.
scenes.visual: Caution card: motor neurons, not NGF-dependent.
scenes.narration: One caution. That result came from motor neurons, and they do not depend on NGF.

scenes.tts: So the graft supports a limiting target resource. It says nothing about which molecule.
scenes.visual: The card adds: supports a limiting target resource; names no molecule.
scenes.narration: So the graft supports a limiting target resource. It says nothing about which molecule.

scenes.tts: Hollyday and Hamburger left open whether the scarce resource was synaptic space or a trophic agent.
scenes.visual: Two candidate icons side by side: synaptic space, trophic agent, with a question mark between.
scenes.narration: Hollyday and Hamburger left open whether the scarce resource was synaptic space or a trophic agent.

scenes.tts: Hold on to the shape of the idea. Make too many, then let the target keep what it can feed.
scenes.visual: Guiding-idea card returns briefly.
scenes.narration: Hold on to the shape of the idea. Make too many, then let the target keep what it can feed.

scenes.tts: The next tests need a molecule. That molecule is nerve growth factor, N G F.
scenes.caption: The next tests need a molecule. That molecule is nerve growth factor, NGF.
scenes.visual: The question mark resolves into a label: nerve growth factor, NGF. Items 3 and 4 highlighted.
scenes.narration: The next tests need a molecule. That molecule is nerve growth factor, NGF.

scenes.tts: Takeaway: the hypothesis predicts reduced death, not extra birth. When counts change, tests must ask which happened.
scenes.visual: Closing card: reduced death, not extra birth.
scenes.narration: Takeaway: the hypothesis predicts reduced death, not extra birth. When counts change, tests must ask which happened.
